failure_summary.description: no minimum cohort size guidance; users try to train on n<50 cohorts and get unstable c-index

edits.content:
## Minimum cohort size

Cox training with TITAN features requires **at least n=80 slides with
uncensored events**; below that, c-index variance dominates the signal.
For cohorts of n=30–80 with mostly uncensored events, prefer the
sksurv elastic-net path; for n<30, fall back to ranking-only metrics or
refuse the run with a clear remediation hint.
